size_modal.title: Measure your foot
steps: Place a sheet of white paper on the floor and stand on it in socks. Keep your weight on both feet.
Mark your heel and the tip of your longest toe with a pencil. Measure the distance in centimetres.
Measure both feet and use the larger one. Find the matching EU size in the chart.

help.title: Help
help.intro: The #1 reason for returns is the wrong size. So measure your foot first: 3 steps, 2 minutes. Everything else — delivery, payment, returns and care — is below.
help.sizes_lead: Sizes are EU, 39–46. Our workshop has a separate last for every size and width — so go by your foot length in the chart, not by another brand's size.
help.sizes_exchange: Wrong size? We'll exchange it for free within 14 days.
help.fit_narrow: Slim foot with a low instep. [From client: which models offer it.]
help.fit_standard: Fits most people. Not sure? Choose Standard.
help.fit_wide: Wide foot or high instep. Ask when ordering or on Telegram.
help.delivery_lead: Across Tashkent — tomorrow, free. Regions: 2–4 days. Order updates come via our Telegram bot or SMS.
help.delivery_courier_note: You can try the shoes on when the courier arrives. [From client: order cut-off time.]

help.care_lead: With proper care, genuine leather lasts for years. [From client: workshop recommendations and cream types.]
help.care_leather: Brush off dust with a soft brush, apply cream in a matching colour and buff with a cloth after 20 minutes.
help.care_suede: Only when dry, with a special rubber brush. Apply water-repellent spray before wearing.
help.care_patent: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. No cream needed; protect from scratches.
care_rules: Don't wear the same pair every day — let the leather rest for a day
Use wooden shoe trees or paper inside — they keep the shape
If they get wet, dry them at room temperature, not next to a radiator
Use a shoehorn — it protects the heel counter

faq.q: I'm between two sizes — which should I choose?
faq.a: Choose the larger one. If your feet are wide, ask for Wide width or get advice on Telegram.

faq.q: Can I try the shoes on when the courier arrives?
faq.a: Yes, in Tashkent the courier will wait. If they don't fit, another size is brought the next day.
